facts.text: I promised Jamie a Turbo Man and I promised him dinner. One of those I can actually deliver tonight.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Howard's words. It is not in the film and the Wikiquote page for the film has no matching line, so I could not find a source for it. It is an invented quote.
facts.fix: I promised Jamie a Turbo Man. Tonight I can only deliver dinner, so sit down and eat.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when Howard hits the toy store on Christmas Eve.

facts.text: Put that cookie down. Have this instead.
facts.why: Unmarked nod to Howard's famous 'Put that cookie down!' line. Plainly a reference. Could not open a quote page to confirm the exact wording, so this rests on memory of the film.
